messages:
alex: quick FYI — PR #3457 can't land until CI is green. mac matrix keeps failing on integration/cache. hitting it in the mac-latest job.
jin: which test exactly? can you paste the failing snippet? :eyes:
alex: failure is in `tests/integration/test_cache.py::test_kv` — stack shows timestamp mismatch in cache TTL logic. local repro flaky.
samir: seen that once. sometimes it's timezone-related on the APAC runners (clock skew). can you share the build id so i can check infra health?
alex: build 4520. i tried a local rerun with `tox -e e2e-mac` — fails ~1/3 runs.
lina: if it's intermittent we should consider splitting the PR: move the schema change in a tiny PR and land it first, then the routing change. smaller surface for rollback and fewer CI flakes to block merges, especially around freeze windows.
alex: good call. we'd like to land before the maintenance freeze on Thu (2024-09-12 02:00 UTC) — apac teams will be impacted otherwise.
ci-bot: re-run triggered by @samir — build 4523 queued (watch at https://ci.redwood.example/build/4523) :hourglass_flowing_sand:
samir: i'll take a look at the runner logs. if it's infra-related i can move the job to a different mac pool.
jin: if re-runs keep failing we should opt for the split and request a fast-track for the schema PR. @lina can you help shepherd reviews? :pray:
lina: yep happy to. i'll mark the split PR with `needs-eyes` and ping the db owners.
alex: thanks. plan: samir repro+investigate infra, open split PR for schema, keep this PR on hold. i'll update this thread with build outcomes.
samir: re-run passed once, failed on second attempt. collecting /var/logs and sharing in the follow-up PR.
alex: re: timing — if the split PR lands, i'll schedule merging the routing change in the Friday APAC-friendly window; otherwise we hold until the next rebase window.
jin: sounds good. @oncall FYI to avoid deployment during the freeze if anything slips. :rotating_light:
oncall: noted — we'll block automatic rollouts during the maintenance window and monitor merge activity.
alex: closing loop — split PR opened: #3460. requesting quick reviews from @lina and @jin. will unhold when both green. :thumbsup:
